# InputSpec

`schemas/records/input-spec.json`

One declared, typed input of a node (docs/design/m0/13 "Model"). The node runs only once each input resolves to a selected, reusable, applicable result (06); until then it waits on that input structurally (13 "Evaluation"). A model node's controller-supplied context is rendered only from its resolved inputs (13 [G7]), so information that no input declares cannot reach it.

## Fields of the document

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | yes | [Name](records-receipt.md#name) | The input's name within its node; internal/graph refuses a duplicate name. |
| `source` | yes | [ResultSource](#resultsource) or [AnswerSource](#answersource) | Where the input's value comes from, discriminated by type. |

No other fields are allowed.

## Definitions

### ResultSource

The selected result of a producer node in the same graph, of exactly the declared kind.

#### Fields of ResultSource

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | yes | `result` |  |
| `producer` | yes | [NodeID](common-defs.md#nodeid) |  |
| `result_kind` | yes | [ResultKind](common-defs.md#resultkind) |  |

No other fields are allowed.

### AnswerSource

The answer to an owed input: an input.answer approval that binds exactly this revision (04 "Owed inputs"). Only a successor review declares it, never the review that asked (13 "Successor rounds"). It resolves to the approval's id and this revision, which is what the computation key hashes for it. A receipt owed input is declared as a result of its evidence node instead, since a ruling never satisfies it; the resolver (G4a) refuses an answer source whose owed input has kind receipt.

#### Fields of AnswerSource

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | yes | `answer` |  |
| `owed_input` | yes | [OwedInputID](common-defs.md#owedinputid) |  |
| `revision` | yes | integer (minimum `1`, maximum `9007199254740991`) |  |

No other fields are allowed.
